review.summary: Adjudication of the four MD reviews (R1-R4 in audit/MD_REVIEWS.json) against the primary pilot files and independent audit (audit/SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md and audit/ADDITIONAL_GEOMETRY_READBACK.json) separates verified implementation and chemical-modeling concerns from unsupported reviewer claims. Specifically, we reject: (1) R1's false claim that GLU_CONTROL places restored ARG(+1) and LYS(+1) side chains at a 1.458 A contact (actual LYS:NZ to ARG guanidino distances are 2.429-4.570 A); (2) R1's harmful recommendations to alter boundary partial charges by +1e-6 e, treat deprotonated ARG0/LYN0 as a physiological control, or delete HarmonicBondForce terms on constrained X-H pairs; (3) R2's unbenchmarked assertion that specific n=1/n=3 biphenyl torsion terms are confirmed errors and R2's arbitrary geometric failure thresholds (1.505 A bond mean and 3-10 deg out-of-plane cutoffs, where unlinked DITY_CONTROL reaches 21.78 deg vs 26.97 deg in DITY_LINKED); (4) R3 and R4's false promotion of the 51.1 CGenFF penalty (an uninstantiated OG312 DOPA-dianion rule) as an active DITY torsion term, as well as R1/R3/R4's causal attribution of GLU_CONTROL replica 0 variance solely to integration precision when the velocity seed also changed; and (5) R3's blanket periodic-wrapping edits on unwrapped covalent bonds and R4's unproven claim that Context.reinitialize(preserveState=True) resets the Langevin PRNG. Surviving priorities are auditing the glucosepane protonation microstate (+1 e vs source 0 e) and absolute (R/S) ring stereochemistry, resolving DITY_LINKED's 8.630 A restrained bond-closure preparation and missing CHARMM parser/QM torsion benchmarks, fixing post-hoc audit script omissions (dry_system.xml reporting, wet-minimization sign-check bypass, and CPU precision labeling), and executing a small geometry/chemical/source validation study before any longer trajectories.

findings.title: R1 misstates the GLU_CONTROL Arg-Lys contact distance and proposes harmful charge and constraint edits, though microstate and stereochemical uncertainty remain valid
findings.evidence: R1 claims GLU_CONTROL places restored ARG(+1) and LYS(+1) side chains at the former 1.458 A crosslink distance (lines 10-11), recommends shifting AGS/LGX charges by +1e-6 e and using deprotonated ARG0/LYN0 as a control (lines 12, 22), and urges deleting constrained X-H pairs from HarmonicBondForce (lines 50-52). Direct coordinate readback in audit/ADDITIONAL_GEOMETRY_READBACK.json (lines 180-185) shows initial LYS:NZ to ARG:NE/CZ/NH1/NH2 distances are 4.570, 3.344, 3.504, and 2.429 A.
findings.implication: The 1.457875 A distance belongs exclusively to the linked AGS:NZ-LGX:CE bond in GLU_LINKED, so R1's claim of a steric/electrostatic explosion from a 1.46 A unlinked contact is false. Deleting harmonic bond terms on holonomically constrained X-H pairs is unjustified because constraints hold bond lengths constant and project force components, and ad hoc +1e-6 e charge tweaks or unvalidated neutral ARG0/LYN0 states corrupt the source Hamiltonian. However, the source neutral AGS/LGX representation (-1e-6 e vs a potentially protonated +1 e cyclic guanidinium state), the +2 e net charge shift between GLU_LINKED (-1 e) and GLU_CONTROL (+1 e), vacuum side-chain minimization (candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 73), and the lack of absolute Cahn-Ingold-Prelog (R/S) verification for the three glucosepane ring stereocenters remain genuine validity limits.
findings.recommended_check: Retain the unmodified source Hamiltonian for baseline reproduction, verify absolute (R/S) configurations of the three AGS ring stereocenters directly from the starting coordinates, audit the source neutral vs protonated (+1 e) glucosepane microstate against experimental pKa data, and treat any charge-modified unlinked states strictly as explicitly labeled sensitivity controls.

findings.title: DITY_LINKED closes an 8.630 A initial gap under backbone restraints, but reviewer claims of active 51.1 penalties, required n=1/n=3 terms, and hard angle gates are unsupported
findings.evidence: Independent readback confirms DITY_LINKED starts with 1CE2-2CE2 separated by 8.6303945 A (copied from unlinked DITY_CONTROL) and closes the bond during backbone-restrained dry minimization (audit/SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md line 5). Across the 30-ps unrestrained window, diagnostic ring out-of-plane angles reach 26.97 deg in DITY_LINKED (line 166) but also 21.78 deg in unlinked DITY_CONTROL (line 50). Meanwhile, R3 and R4 treat CGenFF penalty 51.1 (candidate/PARAMETER_AUDIT.json line 98) as active in DITY, and R2 asserts missing n=1/n=3 torsion terms and 1.505 A / 3-10 deg failure cutoffs (audit/MD_REVIEWS.json lines 81, 90-91, 126).
findings.implication: Pulling an intramolecular Tyr4-Gly5-Tyr6 crosslink closed across 8.630 A while restraining backbone N, CA, C, O atoms risks trapping local conformational strain, and charmm36_dity.xml lacked a second-parser cross-check (candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 65). However, penalty 51.1 applies to an uninstantiated OG312 (DOPA dianion) atom type rather than neutral DITY (where only penalties 41.1 and 30.0 are active), no QM benchmark in the packet proves specific n=1/n=3 Fourier terms are required, and universal 3-10 deg out-of-plane or 1.505 A bond-length rejection rules would falsely invalidate even the unlinked control.
findings.recommended_check: Compare DITY_LINKED prepared via pre-minimization Tyr4/Gly5/Tyr6 rotamer relaxation against the existing 8.630 A closure route, cross-check charmm36_dity.xml energies/forces against OpenMM's native CharmmPsfFile/CharmmParameterSet parser, and benchmark the full 2D inter-ring/hydroxyl torsion surface and out-of-plane angle distributions against QM and unlinked control distributions rather than arbitrary numeric thresholds.

findings.title: R3/R4's blanket PBC-wrapping and PRNG-reset claims are unfounded, whereas dry force-inventory reporting, wet-minimization sign skipping, and CPU precision labels are real audit defects
findings.evidence: In candidate/local_analysis.py, line 33 reads dry_system.xml instead of final_system.xml for force_inventory, and candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 149 defines initial_signs = signs(xm, cs) after wet minimization (ignoring dry m['signs'] from line 91 and omitting the 4th H substituent at line 47), while candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md line 50 states all energy/force comparisons remained in double precision despite line 147 running on the single/mixed-precision CPU platform. Conversely, R4 claims c.reinitialize(preserveState=True) at line 152 resets the integrator RNG (audit/MD_REVIEWS.json line 244), and R3/R4 fault local_analysis.py lines 42, 43, 55, and 57 for unwrapped bond distances and density-scaled box vectors.
findings.implication: Per OpenMM documentation (audit/SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md line 26), reinitialize(preserveState=True) restores state via an internal checkpoint without an established RNG reset (so mid-trajectory reseeding is unwarranted), and getState(enforcePeriodicBox=False) keeps covalent molecules contiguous in unwrapped coordinates (making blanket PBC wrapping of chemical bonds unnecessary and density-ratio isotropic box scaling algebraically exact). By contrast, parsing dry_system.xml misreports vacuum force counts as wet trajectory inventories, resetting initial_signs after wet minimization blinds the stereocenter gate to solvation/wet-minimization inversions, and labeling the wet CPU/CUDA check as double-precision overstates platform check precision.
findings.recommended_check: Update candidate/local_analysis.py line 33 to parse final_system.xml, check wet-minimized signs(xm, cs) directly against dry m['signs'] in candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 149 using all four tetrahedral substituents, and amend candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md line 50 to note that the wet CPU platform check runs in single/mixed precision; do not reseed the integrator at line 152.

findings.title: Confounded precision and velocity seeds in GLU_CONTROL, zero post-restraint burn-in, and single-build pseudo-replication preclude causal variance claims
findings.evidence: GLU_CONTROL combines replica 0 (attempt-001, double precision, seed 20261101, mean C-alpha marker 10.2110 A) with replicas 1 and 2 (attempt-002, mixed precision, seeds 20261102 and 20261103, means 12.5252 A and 11.9192 A). Furthermore, candidate/local_analysis.py line 54 averages all 30 NPT_free frames immediately after dropping the 100 kJ/mol/nm^2 heavy-atom restraint to zero, and all three replicas per model share one solvent build and one minimized starting pose (candidate/CANDIDATE_COMPARISON_RESULTS.md line 32).
findings.implication: Because both numerical precision and the random velocity/thermostat seed changed between GLU_CONTROL replica 0 and replicas 1-2, R1, R3, and R4 cannot causally attribute replica 0's lower C-alpha distance to precision alone (audit/SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md line 15). Moreover, averaging immediately from t = 21 ps mixes post-restraint relaxation drift with thermal fluctuations, while sharing a single solvated starting structure per model provides zero degrees of freedom for independent conformer or ion-atmosphere placement.
findings.recommended_check: Compare the preserved 21-ps double-precision trajectory of GLU_CONTROL replica 1 in attempt-001 against the first 21 ps of mixed-precision replica 1 in attempt-002 (which share seed 20261102), run GLU_CONTROL replica 0 in mixed precision to homogenize the 12-run table, and compute drift slopes, split-half block averages, and autocorrelation times across the 30-ps window.

findings.title: Network regime extensions must account for oxidative bond restoration, zero-modulus tether limits, and exact finite-size line-cut normalization
findings.evidence: In the accompanying coarse-grained network audit (audit/SOURCE_CHECK_NOTES.md lines 17, 30-36), oxidative bridging explicitly restores bonds (alive[new]=True) while simultaneously modifying stretch/bend stiffness, rupture strain, and locked-junction angular terms; pure tether energy 0.5*k_gag*sum|x-FX|^2 relaxes to zero at x = FX when collagen connectivity and mu_el are zero; and the triangular lattice contains 2W cycles (yielding E[z_realized] = 6*p*(1 - 2/(3W)) rather than the 1-1/W formula).
findings.implication: R4's proposal to test whether oxidative dose alters graph connectivity at all (audit/MD_REVIEWS.json line 274) is superseded by code inspection showing dose jointly alters adjacency and mechanical parameters, requiring decoupled interventions. Similarly, reviewer assumptions that k_gag alone guarantees G > 0 at zero connectivity, that mean segment length grows linearly with W under independent dilution, or that universal central-force/bending isostatic thresholds (z_c = 4.0 or 2.4) and fixed tight solver tolerances apply without per-system convergence checks are invalid.
findings.recommended_check: Use recorded realized coordination z_realized (fixing the 1 - 2/(3W) finite-size pre-bridging normalization), decouple adjacency additions from stiffness/angular parameter changes in matched degree-preserving spatial rewirings, run background-limit ablations (mu_el -> 0, k_gag -> 0), and validate relaxed tangent shear modulus G_T via per-system Hessian, force-residual, and strain-step convergence.

review.strongest_surviving_claim: All four solvated peptide models (GLU_CONTROL, GLU_LINKED, DITY_CONTROL, DITY_LINKED) are topologically complete without unresolved force-field parameters, verify dry Reference/CUDA double-precision agreement (plus OpenMM GROMACS-reader equivalence to ~10^-14 kJ/mol/atom for the Amber glucosepane models) and wet CPU/CUDA platform consistency, and complete twelve 50-ps trajectories (360 ps aggregate unrestrained tail) with constraint errors below 7.9e-7 nm and zero post-wet-minimization 3-neighbor stereocenter inversions.
review.decisive_next_experiment: Execute a minimal, bounded validation study prioritizing offline code/geometry checks, source-parameter verification, and preparation controls before any long production MD: (1) Priority 1 — Zero-compute audit and trajectory readback: patch candidate/local_analysis.py line 33 to parse final_system.xml; patch candidate/candidate_pilot.py line 149 to check wet-minimized coordinates xm against dry m['signs'] using all 4 tetrahedral substituents (including H); compute Cahn-Ingold-Prelog (R/S) stereochemistry for the 3 glucosepane ring chiral centers in the starting coordinates; compare the preserved 21-ps double-precision attempt-001 run of GLU_CONTROL replica 1 against the seed-matched mixed-precision attempt-002 run; and compute first-half (21-35 ps) vs second-half (36-50 ps) block means, linear drift slopes, and autocorrelation times for C-alpha markers, DITY 1CE2-2CE2 bond lengths, and central biaryl dihedrals across all 12 existing trajectories. (2) Priority 2 — Parser cross-check and precision homogenization (~5 min compute): cross-check single-point Reference energy and forces of charmm36_dity.xml on DITY_LINKED against OpenMM's CharmmPsfFile/CharmmParameterSet parser loaded from the source CHARMM .psf/.prm/.str files (convergence criterion: energy difference < 1e-5 kJ/mol/atom and force RMS < 1e-2 kJ/mol/nm), and run a single 50-ps mixed-precision trajectory of GLU_CONTROL replica 0 (seed 20261101) to balance precision across all 12 runs. (3) Priority 3 — Pre-MD chemical and initial-geometry validation: (a) for DITY_LINKED, generate a rotamer-relaxed starting structure (sampling Tyr4/Gly5/Tyr6 backbone/side-chain dihedrals before bond closure so 1CE2-2CE2 starts near covalent distance without 8.630 A backbone-pinned pulling) and benchmark the 2,2'-biphenol / capped-DITY torsion surface (central CA-CG2R67-CG2R67-CA rotor and penalty-41.1/30.0 intra-ring terms) against a 1D/2D QM torsion scan, comparing MD out-of-plane angle and bond distributions directly against DITY_CONTROL and QM minima rather than arbitrary angle cutoffs; (b) for glucosepane, construct and verify a protonated (+1 e) cyclic-guanidinium AGS/LGX parameter set alongside the source neutral (0 e) model and include weak terminal C-alpha positional anchors (representing the omitted triple-helical scaffold) plus an explicitly labeled charge-sensitivity control across >= 3 independent solvent/ion-placement builds. Stop criteria: complete parser agreement, verified (R/S) stereochemistry, absence of wet-minimization sign inversions, and stationary split-half block means within 1 SEM before launching multi-nanosecond sampling. Falsifiers: if seed-matched double vs mixed precision trajectories of GLU_CONTROL replica 1 diverge by LESS than the inter-seed spread of replicas 1-2, reject the reviewer claim that precision caused the 1.20 A GLU_CONTROL variance; if rotamer-relaxed DITY_LINKED initialization produces the same 1CE2-2CE2 bond length and out-of-plane angle distribution as the 8.630 A dry-minimization closure, reject the trapped-minimization-strain hypothesis; if terminal C-alpha tethering and charge-sensitivity controls account for the GLU_CONTROL vs GLU_LINKED C-alpha shift, reject attributing the pilot marker difference to covalent crosslink stiffness.
